unresolved.question: Rows 1-2: band ১ printed inside a single circle over the final alif of ضَبْحًا, قَدْحًا, صُبْحًا and نَقْعًا, جَمْعًا (tanween fath at the ayah end); recorded as enclosure circle, label এক আলিফ (legend shows only the double-ring variant as দম ফেলিলে এক আলিফ).
Surah 101 header prints মাদানী (al-Qari'ah is usually listed as Makki); transcribed as printed.
Page legend (partly cut) prints শিষ for শ and lists ২ = ইখফা; labels follow the existing convention (শীষ, ইখফা).
Row 1 word فَالْمُغِيْرٰتِ: band ১ম১ sits over يْ and رٰ; ম anchored to رٰ though it may belong to غ.
